sources.title: mindlab-research/Macaron-V1-Coding-Venti · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Macaron-V1-Coding-Venti is the coding-specialist checkpoint in the Macaron-V1 family. It is produced by merging the Macaron-V1-Venti L2 Coding LoRA specialist into the GLM-5.2 BF16 base model, yielding a single merged checkpoint for coding, terminal, repository, and software-engineering workflows.

sources.title: GitHub - MindLab-Research/Mixture-of-LoRA-Harness
sources.snippet: Mixture-of-LoRA Harness serves two model profiles: Macaron-V1-Venti, a 748B-parameter model composed of a 744B GLM-5.2 base model and four 1B LoRA specialists. Macaron-V1-Tall, a 50B-parameter model composed of a 35B Qwen3.6-35B-A3B base model and four 3.7B Rank-64 LoRA specialists. One process exposes one OpenAI-compatible model.
